feeds.title: Sunny Sweet Days
feeds.description: The purpose of this site is to inspire busy, creative families to cook more, travel more, and find purpose in everyday life. Krystal is a florida food and lifestyle blogger, She loves to visit quirky local restaurants, theme parks, beaches, and unique attractions to cover on her social media accounts and this website.

feeds.title: Lifestyle Magazine
feeds.description: Lifestyle Media covers all the latest trends in South Florida with news and articles on fashion, food & drink, dining, arts & culture, travel, real estate, beauty, and style throughout the area. Lifestyle Media Group is the largest magazine publisher in South Florida.

feeds.title: Meet at the Barre
feeds.description: Florida lifestyle blog with a focus on fashion, fitness, health, and travel. Authored by Amanda Elizabeth, a mommy, former barre instructor, Nurse Practitioner, travel guide maker, who tries to fit it all into 24 hours.

feeds.title: Fresh Mommy Blog
feeds.description: I'm Tabitha Blue. A Life Coach, Speaker, Author, Mom of 6 & Professional Encourager who created this space to support, equip and inspire you on your journey to creating a life you love.Fresh Mommy Blog is where I share my family's lives, travels, and my attempt at domesticity.

feeds.title: That Florida Life
feeds.description: That Florida Life was created as a way to bring happiness to others by helping them live the Florida lifestyle they've been dreaming about whether they are looking to move to Florida or already live here. Fun things to do, shopping, entertainment, beaches, events, great towns, outdoor activities, neighborhoods, real estate & more!

feeds.title: Ria Michelle Blog
feeds.description: Ria Michelle, a Miami-based style blogger and influencer, delves into fashion, food, and travel. Through her blog, she preserves cherished moments and inspires global audiences with her journey. Sharing looks, tips, and hotspots, she captivates with authenticity and creativity, aiming to inspire and connect.

feeds.title: SoooBoca
feeds.description: Discover all things fun and fabulous in Boca Raton, Florida! Explore our beautiful beaches, real estate, decadent dining, shop till you drop stores, entertainment, and lifestyle destination in the heart of South Florida! Michele Bellisari is a Realtor and founder of SoooBoca, a lifestyle guide about Boca Raton, South Florida, and Florida.

feeds.title: XO, Ayana
feeds.description: XO, Ayana is a blog curated by influencer Ayana Lage. The blog features posts about Tampa, marriage, fashion, lifestyle and more.

feeds.title: A Glam Lifestyle
feeds.description: A Glam Lifestyle is a fashion and lifestyle blog by Amanda Champion. Its a destination site for the everyday woman who is managing work, family and wants to stay über chic and glamorous while on the go.

feeds.title: Lifestyle with Laramie Blog
feeds.description: Lifestyle blog featuring everything lifestyle, fashion, and home decor. By Laramie Otto, a recent graduate from the University of Central Florida.

feeds.title: Central Florida Chic
feeds.description: Welcome to Central Florida Chic! Danielle, the founder, has shared her fashion passion since 2018. Discover affordable deals and savings on big-name designers like Lilly Pulitzer and Dolce and Gabbana. Subscribe for the latest sale updates and designer finds, making chic style accessible to all.

feeds.title: MiamiCurated
feeds.description: Dive into the welcome to the MiamiCurated blog, packed with content on Food worth the calories (WTC), stylish fashion with flair, and world-class culture in Miami. You'll read about other South Florida highlights and things to do — from must see art shows and entertainment, to weekend getaways and foodie finds.

feeds.title: Ashley Brooke Nicholas
feeds.description: Ashley Brooke Nicholas is a beauty, fashion, travel, home decor, lifestyle and motherhood blogger based in Orlando, Florida. She is passionate about creating a positive online community for women to help them make the most of each and every day.

feeds.title: Ohdeardrea
feeds.description: Ohdeardrea is a holistic lifestyle blog focusing on family, simple pleasures, vegan cooking, gardening, home and design, travel, tropical living and all things creative and aesthetically pleasing.

feeds.title: Emily Godoy
feeds.description: Emily G is a South Florida-based fashion blog covering fashion, beauty and lifestyle as inspiration for the modern girl. Emily's hope is to inspire the modern girl embrace their personal style, effortlessly.

feeds.title: Style Delegate
feeds.description: Maya D created Style Delegate to share her passions and insights with other coffee chugging, laptop toting, travel-loving-career-women around the world, who seek to ADVANCE in life, CREATE Joy, + EXPLORE the world, in STYLE!

feeds.title: Aline Lowry
feeds.description: Aline gives travel tips and ideas through her blogs and she also gives details of hotels, cruises and places to visit. Aline truly believes that style comes from the inside of each one of us. You don't have to break the bank to be stylish.

feeds.title: Ashley Brooke
feeds.description: Elevating the everyday through girl-next-door style, beauty tutorials, and home & lifestyle inspiration. Here you'll find a daily dose of my favorite things across beauty, home, lifestyle, and travel. From makeup tutorials and healthy recipes to my latest finds and home DIY's.

feeds.title: Sweet Humble Home
feeds.description: Here, you'll find everything you need to get your party planned, family recipes, new delicious treats, food & drinks, everyday entertaining tips, and the steps to put it all together to share with friends & family. Authored by JJ Rose who loves to entertain.

feeds.title: A Raad Story
feeds.description: South Florida Parenting blog that shines light on the joys of pregnancy, postpartum, and motherhood. Offering practical tips on motherhood journey and life with little ones from a Broward mom. A Raad Story helps build up and encourage the everyday woman to have a positive outlook in her daily life by offering an optimistic perspective of our daily adventures as a new loving family.

feeds.title: Sara Magnolia
feeds.description: A New England native currently residing in Florida, Sara Magnolia, shares her inspiration on fashion, beauty, and home decor along with her travels along the way.
